status: protocol fixed; isolated-task method awaiting user selection
question: Do the four Skills add measurable value beyond a same-model, same-requirement implementation?

treatments.skill: read the four fixed Skill documents and use their implementation toolkits
treatments.direct: no Skill documents, toolkit code, prior recipes, generated assets or ocean module

shared: same three-chapter host, gameplay rules, Q ability, input, UI, loaders and event bindings; common infrastructure is excluded from Skill benefits
model: same currently selected model, inherited unchanged; backend identity only reported if exposed
context: fresh tasks must not inherit this conversation; current-chat rewrite would be labelled contaminated and exploratory
deliverables: 4 low-poly GLB assets: sentinel, guardian, cannon, beacon
2 transparent 24-frame VFX atlases: tide and impact
animated harbor water with wave-driven boat buoyancy
build recipes, manifests and validation records
outOfScope: Q damage, armor breaking, interruption and projectile clearing
general game quality improvements shared between arms

timePolicy.freshRuns: wall clock begins when the fixed task is dispatched; environment preparation and shared harness reported separately
timePolicy.rebuild: same machine, warmed environment, sequential repeated runs; keep raw samples; no mixing rebuild time with AI authoring time

reworkPolicy.definition: a correction after an executable candidate or generated output fails a predeclared check; separate runtime/API failures from visual or audible revisions
reworkPolicy.evidence: retain candidate hashes, command exit status, failed check and changed files; do not infer counts from final code

evaluation: same frozen technical rubric for both arms
same camera, lighting, viewport and timing for screenshots/video
same peak/headroom reporting and event-volume controls for audio
same hardware and rendering quality for performance
visual/audio preference remains unmeasured until user review; no invented preference scores
limits: one case cannot establish general superiority
same model is not identical stochastic output
prior existing Skill run lacks reliable total time and rework counts
if context isolation is declined, prior exposure must remain a stated limitation
